# Pointer Creek Wealth Management

> A fiduciary, fee-based CFP® practice providing private wealth management and financial
> planning to high-net-worth investors in Northeast Ohio. Tagline: "See the unseen." A
> branch office of Cambridge Investment Research, Inc. Small by design, CFP®-only, no
> quotas, no proprietary products. Managed-account minimum: $500,000+ in net investible
> assets; planning is scoped to complexity, not size.

Location: 201 South Broad Street, Canfield, Ohio 44406 · Phone: (234) 414-1014 · Email: team@pointercreek.com · Serves: Northeast Ohio (Mahoning Valley).

- [Who We Serve](https://www.pointercreek.com/who-we-serve.html): Ideal clients, mindset, the $500,000+ minimum, and the life situations we handle best.
- [Our Process — How We Actually Work](https://www.pointercreek.com/how-we-work.html): From first conversation and mutual-fit meeting to thorough planning, documentation, and long-term partnership; no AUM quotas or hidden agenda.
- [Investment Philosophy](https://www.pointercreek.com/investment-philosophy.html): Planning before investing, why we don’t chase hot tips, risk capacity vs. tolerance vs. appetite, activity is not progress, and moving from active money to patient capital ("boring money").

## Services
- [Fee-Based Financial Planning](https://www.pointercreek.com/fee-based-planning.html): Major financial decisions planned before they become expensive mistakes — personal/family and business planning.
- [Trust & Estate Planning](https://www.pointercreek.com/trust-estate-planning.html): Wills, trusts, powers of attorney, beneficiary reviews, trust funding, and implementation follow-through. We coordinate with your attorney; we do not draft legal documents.
- [Fiduciary Wealth Management](https://www.pointercreek.com/wealth-management.html): Low-fee strategies built on academic research; ETFs, index and institutional funds, individual securities, and private placements for accredited investors.
- [Fiduciary Risk Management](https://www.pointercreek.com/risk-management.html): What would actually happen to cash flow, the business, and the surviving spouse. Fixed insurance through B Renner LLC.

- [Resources](https://www.pointercreek.com/resources.html): Planning agreements, tax & contribution tables, Social Security key numbers, calculators, and helpful links.

## Compliance
Securities offered through Cambridge Investment Research, Inc., a broker-dealer, member FINRA/SIPC. Investment advisory services offered through Cambridge Investment Research Advisors, Inc., a Registered Investment Advisor. Fixed insurance services offered through B Renner LLC, an unaffiliated Ohio insurance agency. Cambridge does not offer tax or legal advice.
